description: This file defines mock request handlers for testing authentication and user data retrieval using the MSW (Mock Service Worker) library. It includes handlers for login and fetching user info, simulating session-based authentication.

methods.name: http.post
methods.description: Creates a request handler for POST requests to '/login' that sets session authentication.

methods.name: http.get
methods.description: Creates a request handler for GET requests to '/user' that returns user info if authenticated.
